identity.name: SSH Brute Force on the Linux Syslog Auth Feed
identity.summary: SSH Brute Force on the Linux Syslog Auth Feed — collector/log-level detection on the Linux host syslog feed (dataset=linux_syslog).
identity.description: SSH Brute Force on the Linux Syslog Auth Feed. The attacker behavior is visible in the Linux host auth/syslog that is forwarded to a Cortex Broker VM syslog applet (parsed into dataset=linux_syslog) — a collector/log-level detection, not the endpoint-agent process feed. CortexSim drives linux_syslog_emitter.py to reproduce the detectable syslog telemetry; no real host is touched.

execution.framework_reference_id: T1003.008 — Atomic Test #1 (Access /etc/shadow) and T1552.001 credential-file sweep

prerequisites.description: Cortex XDR Linux agent installed and reporting healthy on the target.
prerequisites.check_command: systemctl is-active cortex-agent || ps aux | grep -i traps

prerequisites.description: Lab environment matching scenario SIM-EDR-001 requirements (a Linux host with a www-data service account).

payload.code:
# Collector/log-level validation — stream shape-true Linux auth/syslog to the lab Broker VM.
COLLECTOR="${BROKER_VM:-192.0.2.9}"
python3 core/eal_simulator/linux_syslog_emitter.py --collector "$COLLECTOR" --phase baseline --baseline-count 40
python3 core/eal_simulator/linux_syslog_emitter.py --collector "$COLLECTOR" --phase attack --which ssh-brute-force

iocs.context: Source IP of the SSH brute-force burst in this scenario.

xql_queries.name: SSH Failed-Password Burst From One Source
xql_queries.query:
dataset = linux_syslog
| filter process = "sshd" and message contains "Failed password"
| comp count() as fails by src_ip, host
| filter fails >= 5

xql_queries.name: SSH Brute Force Followed by an Accepted Login
xql_queries.query:
dataset = linux_syslog
| filter process = "sshd"
| comp count() as attempts by src_ip, host
| filter attempts >= 5

threat_scenarios.name: Endpoint Credential Theft Detection — Linux
threat_scenarios.description: Detect Linux credential harvesting (passwd/shadow access, SSH key sweeps, /proc scraping, Mimipenguin) by a non-root service account before it enables lateral movement.

threat_steps.objective: Cortex XDR BIOCs fire on shadow access and the credential-file sweep from www-data.
preconditions: Cortex XDR Linux agent >= 8.4.0 installed and healthy.
BIOCs from this card imported and enabled.
steps: Observe BIOC alerts in the Cortex console.
success_criteria: BIOC `EDR-001 Shadow File Read by Non-Root Service Account` fires within 60s.
BIOC `EDR-001 Broad Credential File Sweep Across Home Directories` fires within 60s.
Both XQL validation queries return >= 1 row.

threat_steps.objective: Mimipenguin download-and-execute is detected and stitched with prior recon.
success_criteria: BIOC `EDR-001 Mimipenguin Credential Dumper Execution` fires.
IOC match on the mimipenguin.sh download URL.
Correlation `CR-EDR-0001` produces a single credential-access incident.

preventive_controls: Restrict /etc/shadow to root:shadow 0640 and audit reads with auditd.
Run web/app services under least-privilege accounts with no shell and no sudo.
Store SSH private keys with passphrases; prefer short-lived certificates.
Block outbound egress from server tiers to public code-hosting unless allowlisted.
detection_engineering: Allowlist legitimate readers of /etc/shadow (e.g., pam, login) and alert on all others.
Hunt for find processes referencing id_rsa/.pgpass and for /proc/*/environ reads by non-owning processes.
Correlate tool-download URLs with subsequent process execution from /tmp.
